title: Admin Stats Endpoint — Total Active Users
last_note: Implemented GET /users/internal/stats in UserProfileController (reusing TryAuthorizeInternalCall + IUserRepository.CountActiveUsersAsync, no new service layer/migration needed since AccountStatus/IsOnboardingComplete already exist), and added getStats()/PlatformStats to admin-service's Java UserServiceClient + UserServiceClientImpl (WebClient + CircuitBreaker, no fallback, same convention as getSuspendedUsers). No dotnet ef command required — no schema change.
